intended_use: L1 layout detection only. Use target_hp_bar as ROI for L2 bar meter; do not use this model as target_kind or player classifier.
limitations: Labels are reviewed fixed-geometry target panel/hp/name boxes.
target_kind/player/boss classification is not trained in this artifact.
hp_state is not predicted by this detector; it requires L2 bar/color logic or a separate classifier.
